folded.subject: Certainly
folded.object: Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ EN: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah.

[16] AR: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

folded.id: he who|does|not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another
folded.subject: he who
folded.object: not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another

spans.text: [4] AR: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ EN: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons.

folded.id: he who|is|unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons
folded.subject: he who
folded.object: unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons

spans.text: [4] AR: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ EN: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons.

folded.id: his messenger|are|abased as those before them were abased
folded.subject: His Messenger
folded.object: abased as those before them were abased

spans.text: [5] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased.

folded.id: never|will|their wealth or their children avail them against allah at all
folded.subject: Never
folded.object: their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all

spans.text: [17] AR: لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ EN: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all.

folded.id: nor|are|there five but that he is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that he is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are
folded.subject: nor
folded.object: there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are

spans.text: There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are.

folded.id: private conversation|is|only from satan that he may grieve those who have believed
folded.subject: Private conversation
folded.object: only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed

spans.text: [10] AR: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah.

folded.id: that allah|knows|what is in the heavens and what is on the earth?
folded.subject: that Allah
folded.object: what is in the heavens and what is on the earth?

spans.text: [7] AR: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ EN: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth?
That is better for you and purer.

folded.id: that|is|for you to believe [completely] in allah and his messenger
folded.subject: That
folded.object: for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger

spans.text: That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah.
That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.

folded.id: their mothers|are|none but those who gave birth to them
folded.subject: Their mothers
folded.object: none but those who gave birth to them

spans.text: Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them.

folded.id: then he|will|inform them of what they did
folded.subject: Then He
folded.object: inform them of what they did

spans.text: Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection.

folded.id: there|is|in no private conversation three but that he is the fourth of them
folded.subject: There
folded.object: in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them

spans.text: There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are.
They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

folded.id: they|are|neither of you nor of them
folded.subject: They
folded.object: neither of you nor of them

spans.text: They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

[2] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ EN: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers.

folded.id: they|are|saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood
folded.subject: they
folded.object: saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood

spans.text: And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood.
Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
And upon Allah let the believers rely.

folded.id: when allah|will|resurrect them all and inform them of what they did
folded.subject: when Allah
folded.object: resurrect them all and inform them of what they did

spans.text: [6] AR: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ EN: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did.
And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees.

[11] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ EN: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you.
And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees.

folded.id: which allah|does|not greet you and say among themselves
folded.subject: which Allah
folded.object: not greet you and say among themselves

spans.text: And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?"
Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

[14] AR: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ EN: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry?
And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.

folded.id: why|does|allah not punish us for what we say?"
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: Allah not punish us for what we say?"

spans.text: And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?"
